svg.title: 407 repositories in orbit
svg.desc: A rotating 3D sphere with one point for each of 407 public repositories, sized by stars and colored by section. Robinhood Chain: 22; x402 payments and agent commerce: 84; MCP servers for AI agents: 78; 3D AI agents and avatars: 58; Solana and pump.fun tooling: 20; DeFi mechanisms and Uniswap v4 hooks: 47; On-chain experiments and collectibles: 67; Developer tools and everything else: 31.
